children: Medalist Diversified entered a joint venture with Spandrel, committing $4.0 million for a 42% preferred equity stake and securing a 6% current preferred return plus a 9% accrued return at exit. The company also agreed to provide a limited guaranty to support an approximately $13.5 million construction loan for the JV, expected to close within 30 days. Separately, Medalist reinstated and amended a purchase agreement to acquire a Caliber Collision property in Aubrey, Texas, reducing the price to $5,404,864 and setting a seven-day inspection period while the seller retains the prior earnest money. Together, these steps advance Medalist’s real estate investment pipeline and financing plan.
